title: Problems Center: replace zero-count display with a meaningful empty state and actionable guidance
goal: The Problems Center screen (screen-problems-center) currently shows counts like '0 confirmed - 0 suspected - 0 discounted' when no findings exist. Showing three zeros in a row with no context tells the operator nothing useful. Replace this display pattern with: (1) when no findings at all exist across all engagements: a single sentence 'No open problems — findings from completed runs appear here.' with a 'Go to Mission Control' action, (2) when findings exist but all are resolved: 'All problems resolved. Start a new run to re-validate.' (3) keep the count summary only when count > 0 for at least one category. Also verify that the count summary logic is correct: 'confirmed', 'suspected', 'discounted' are finding statuses — ensure these match the actual finding status values returned by the API.
scope: System review 2026-05-01: Problems Center shows '0 confirmed - 0 suspected - 0 discounted' when empty. Three zeros in sequence provide no value and look like a broken counter. The screen also needs guidance on what types of findings appear here vs Findings Theater.
generation_reason: System review 2026-05-01: Problems Center shows '0 - 0 - 0' counts with no guidance when empty — replace with meaningful empty state.
